Explanation:  
The question asks for the number of years the station that preceded Salthill and Monkstown (i.e., Seapoint) had been open as of Christmas Day 2005. The Ground Truth Answer states 143 years. The Predicted Answer says 142 years. Seapoint opened in 1863; counting from 1863 to 2005 (inclusive) is 143 years (2005 - 1863 + 1 if counting calendar years including the opening year, or 2005 - 1863 if only counting full years elapsed). On Christmas Day 2005, the station would have completed 142 full years (from Dec 1863 to Dec 2005 is 142 years), turning 143 only on the anniversary in December 2006. Therefore, based strictly on the Ground Truth (143 years), the Predicted Answer (142 years) does not match.

Decision: FALSE
